articles.title: Ledger claims CryptoBilis cases are limited as up to $93 million is traced, $10 million frozen
articles.snippet: Ledger said every confirmed case involves devices sold by the Southeast Asian reseller, but critics say the hardware-wallet maker must answer for an authorized sales channel.

articles.title: Everyone wants SCOTUS to take up prediction markets: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: The U.S. Supreme Court hasn't yet indicated whether it will take up cases surrounding prediction markets, but there are now several amicus briefs, an interim final rule and a rule proposal.

articles.title: Bitcoin's $19 billion wake-up call: One-year after flash crash, has crypto learned anything?
articles.snippet: The Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets. Traders now have better tools to spot risks, but the forces behind the selloff remain.

articles.title: FTX’s crypto mining venture is now used to advance AI
articles.snippet: The defunct exchange acquired a 20% stake in Genesis Digital Assets before FTX declared bankruptcy in November 2022.

articles.title: US accounting overhaul could make stablecoins more attractive to corporations: Tempo
articles.snippet: A Tempo report examines how proposed US accounting rules could change corporate stablecoin holdings, with direct redemption rights determining which tokens qualify as cash.
